ITEM 1 | Scrambled eggs, pale yellow with orange-tinged flecks, soft and fluffy curds, moist-looking with slight sheen, clumped in a mound covering the upper-left portion of the plate, roughly 9 cm across and about 2 cm tall | 110
ITEM 2 | Cubed roasted sweet potato pieces, deep orange-brown with caramelized darker edges and a glossy glazed sheen, firm edges, cubes about 2-3 cm each, scattered across the lower-left of the plate covering roughly a quarter of the plate, about 2 cm tall | 150
ITEM 3 | Pan-cooked bacon strips, reddish-brown with darker crisp edges, flat slices folded and overlapping, slightly glossy with some rendered fat, sitting to the right of the eggs and partly under the melon, roughly 8 cm by 5 cm, about 0.5 cm thick | 45
ITEM 4 | Fresh melon cubes, pale green flesh with lighter edges, firm and moist-looking with a slight wet surface, cut into irregular chunks about 2-3 cm, arranged in a cluster on the right side of the plate, roughly 8 cm by 9 cm, about 2 cm tall | 120
